web_heroKicker: Free liver health check for India
web_heroTitle: Is your liver healthy? Find out in 2 minutes.
web_heroBody: LivrCheck screens for fatty liver and related risks to your heart, kidneys, lungs and blood sugar — then helps you build healthy daily habits. No blood report needed.
web_featuresTitle: Everything you need to look after your liver
web_featuresSub: One simple app: a health check, a daily habit tracker and a guide written for Indian families.
web_aboutTitle: Fatty liver is common — and often silent
web_aboutBody: Fatty liver usually has no symptoms in its early stages, so many people find out late. The good news: with the right food, activity, sleep and check-ups it can often improve.
web_aboutCta: Learn the stages of fatty liver
web_how1Body: No account needed. Answer 15 simple questions — add your blood report (AST, ALT, platelets) for a FIB-4 score if you have one.
web_how2Body: Get your liver and health score, what it means, and simple food, exercise and habit tips made for you.
web_how3Body: Create a free account if you like, to save your results and log water, food, exercise, steps and sleep. Earn coins and keep your streak alive.
web_guideSub: 6 chapters and 27 short topics — free to read, with advice for children, adults and older adults.
web_foodsSub: What to eat more of, and what to limit. Tap a card for nutrients, safe amounts and better swaps.
web_stepsSub: Five habits from the LivrCheck fatty liver guidebook.
web_faqSub: Choose an age group to see the answers that fit.
web_mythsMore: Read myths vs facts in the guide
web_appBody: The same account works on the website and on the LivrCheck Android app (coming soon to Google Play). Your check-ins, coins and results stay in sync.
web_ctaTitle: Start looking after your liver today
web_ctaBody: It's free, takes 2 minutes, and works in your language.
web_footerAbout: A free screening and healthy-habit tool for people in India. Not a diagnosis — always talk to your doctor.
